info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM and eSIM Status API provides real-time access to the status of telecom SIM and eSIM cards. This endpoint enables users to check the operational status of their SIM and eSIM cards, offering insights into their connectivity and availability. Typical consumers of this API include mobile service providers, developers of telecom applications, and enterprise IT systems managing mobile assets. Use this API to enhance customer support and streamline service management for telecom applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of the eSIM, providing essential information about its activation, availability, and any related issues. It serves as a crucial tool for managing eSIM functionalities within applications.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of the eSIM operation. It contains the necessary parameters to fetch the current status of the eSIM.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, returning the current eSIM status.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of an eSIM operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the eSIM operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on eSIM status.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in understanding the performance of the operation.
